source_refs.note: Exercise 3.5, Question 7: integral of f from f(x) + f(-x); book p. 102. Key on p. 300 under 'Exercise 3.2' (8/3). The printed condition x^2 + x^3 is impossible; corrected to x^2.

blocks.text: Sawal jaisa hona chahiye (durust kar ke): Maan lein \(f(x)\) aisa function hai ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(x) + f(-x) = x^2\) ho. Definite integral \(\int_{-2}^{2} f(x)\,dx\) ki value nikaalein. Kitab mein right side \(x^2 + x^3\) chhapi hai; neeche wajah dekhiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein condition \(f(x) + f(-x) = x^2 + x^3\) chhapi hai, lekin aisa koi function ho hi nahi sakta. \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein: left side \(f(-x) + f(x)\) wohi rehti hai, magar right side \(x^2 - x^3\) ban jati hai; yani har \(x\) ke liye \(x^3 = 0\) chahiye, jo ghalat hai. (Misaal: \(x = 1\) par condition kehti hai \(f(1) + f(-1) = 2\), aur \(x = -1\) par wohi cheez \(0\).) Left side hamesha even hoti hai, is liye sirf even hissa \(x^2\) hi mumkin hai: \(f(x) + f(-x) = x^2\) (jaise \(f(x) = \frac{x^2}{2} + x^3\)). Is se jawab \(\frac{8}{3}\) aata hai, jo answer key mein hai. Chhapi hui condition ke saath do sahi tareeqe do alag jawab (\(\frac{8}{3}\) aur \(\frac{20}{3}\)) dete hain, jo khud saboot hai ke data ghalat hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 Let \(f(x)\) be a function satisfying \(f(x) + f(-x) = x^2\) [printed as \(x^2 + x^3\); see the correction above] for all \(x\). Evaluate the definite integral \(\int_{-2}^{2} f(x)\,dx\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(f\) ka formula nahi diya, sirf \(f(x) + f(-x)\) diya hai, aur interval \([-2, 2]\) symmetric hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) + f(-x)\) ki value (durust shakal \(x^2\)).
Find kya karna hai? \(\int_{-2}^{2} f(x)\,dx\).
Rule kaunsa? Property V symmetric interval wale integral ko \(\int_0^a [f(x) + f(-x)]\,dx\) mein badal deti hai, yani bilkul wohi cheez jo humein di gayi hai. Is liye yeh property is sawal ke liye bani hai.
Plan: pehle samjhein ke chhapi hui condition kyun ghalat hai, phir Property V, phir doosre tareeqe se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: har \(x\) ke liye \(f(x) + f(-x) = x^2\) (kitab mein \(x^2 + x^3\)).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{-2}^{2} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: Property V, \(a = 2\): \(\int_{-a}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} \big(f(x) + f(-x)\big)\,dx\).

Chhapi hui condition kyun durust karni pari
\[x \to -x:\ f(-x) + f(x) = x^2 - x^3\]
\[\Rightarrow\ x^2 + x^3 = x^2 - x^3\]
Kyun: \(f(x) + f(-x)\) mein \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein to wohi do terms ulti tarteeb mein aa jati hain, yani left side nahi badalti. To right side bhi nahi badalni chahiye. \(x^2\) nahi badalta lekin \(x^3\) ka sign badal jata hai, is liye \(x^3\) kisi sachi condition ka hissa nahi ho sakta.
Dhyan dein: \(f(x) + f(-x)\) hamesha even function hota hai; yeh baat aise sawalon mein bohat kaam aati hai.

Property V lagayein
\[\int_{-2}^{2} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{2} \big(f(x) + f(-x)\big)\,dx\]
\[= \int_{0}^{2} x^2\,dx\]
Kyun: Property V ne left aur right aadhon ko jor kar \([0, 2]\) par \(f(x) + f(-x)\) bana diya, aur yeh humein maloom hai.

Doosra tareeqa (jis par answer key chalti hai)
\[I = \int_{-2}^{2} f(-x)\,dx\]
\[2I = \int_{-2}^{2} \big(f(x) + f(-x)\big)\,dx\]
\[= \int_{-2}^{2} x^2\,dx = \dfrac{16}{3},\quad I = \dfrac{8}{3}\]
Kyun: Property IV(ii) (\(b = 2\)) se \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakh sakte hain, to \(I\) ki doosri shakal mili; dono jama kiye. Chhapi hui \(x^2 + x^3\) ke saath yeh tareeqa bhi \(\frac{8}{3}\) deta hai (kyunke \(\int_{-2}^{2} x^3\,dx = 0\)), lekin Property V \(\int_0^2 (x^2 + x^3)\,dx = \frac{20}{3}\) deti hai. Do sahi tareeqon se do alag jawab aana saboot hai ke chhapa hua data mumkin hi nahi.

Tasdeeq: ek misaal se
\[f(x) = \dfrac{x^2}{2} + x^3:\ f(x) + f(-x) = x^2\]
\[\int_{-2}^{2} \left(\dfrac{x^2}{2} + x^3\right)dx = \dfrac{8}{3} + 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: yeh function durust condition poori karta hai (\(x^3\) wale hisse cancel ho jate hain), aur is ka integral bhi \(\frac{8}{3}\) aata hai: \(\frac{x^2}{2}\) ka integral \(\frac{8}{3}\) aur odd \(x^3\) ka 0. Answer key mein bhi \(\frac{8}{3}\) hai.
